reason: The original pre-cap candidate identities were not frozen, so exact reproduction of the original 88 selected announcement_ids cannot be independently tested before any real CNINFO query. The exact replay requirement remains mandatory but moves to the first point at which the census candidate pool exists.

must_pass: Parent contract and preimplementation audit bindings are exact.
The three admitted development manifests match frozen SHA256/count bindings and are pairwise disjoint.
Collector, triage, classifier and 18-term registry bindings are frozen.
Exactly 730 inclusive dates from 2023-01-01 through 2024-12-30 and exactly 105 deterministic contiguous non-overlapping transport partitions of at most seven days are constructed.
Every transport date is covered exactly once and no date outside the frozen range is queried.
The census inclusion/materialization path contains no six-per-window cap and no per-security diversity cap.
The old-design replay algorithm passes synthetic order-invariance, six-per-window cap, one-security-per-window diversity, deduplication and deterministic SHA256 ordering tests.
Temporal provenance uses only the frozen 2023-2024 joint calendar and a strictly later joint session exists for every allowed disclosure date.
Production source collection/classification imports no price, return, benchmark, transaction-cost, candidate-outcome, fold3, fold4, strategy-evaluator, live or brokerage source.
Runner blob SHA and Phase-A PASS validation receipt are frozen before any real query.

phase_b_after_census_candidate_pool_befo.required_replay_input: The complete deduped, frozen-triaged, admitted-development-universe census candidate pool, restricted to each of the original 56 frozen windows.
phase_b_after_census_candidate_pool_befo.security_diversity: At most one selected filing per canonical_security_id within each original window.
phase_b_after_census_candidate_pool_befo.required_exact_result: Exactly reproduce the original frozen set of 88 selected announcement_ids.
phase_b_after_census_candidate_pool_befo.mismatch_scientific_effect: H1/H3 attribution and terminal READY/TOO_SPARSE classification are inadmissible.

forbidden: No mutation of the original V2.9 Historical E Development Source TOO_SPARSE result.
No change to source windows, census range, 18-term registry, triage, classifier, positive definition, temporal rule or information floor to rescue sample size.
No price, return, benchmark, transaction-cost, candidate-outcome, strategy, live or brokerage data.
No use of the frozen 88 selected rows as their own replay input.
No claim that synthetic replay tests satisfy the Phase-B exact-88 requirement.
precedence: For validation timing only, this clarification supersedes the parent contract sentence requiring exact-88 dry replay before real collection. All other parent-contract requirements remain in force.
